title: A Strange Advertisement Appearing In The "Sin Wan Pao"

page_data.en:
FORM NO. 3
G./65M-1-39

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
                              S.5, Special Branch Subtd. 9417
REPORT                        Date September 4, 1939. 6 9 39

Subject (in full)......A strange advertisement appearing in the "Sin Wan Pao"
                       on August 31, 1939.

Made by................and........................Forwarded by.......D.S.I. Golder

With reference to the attached translation of an
advertisement appearing in the "Sin Wan Pao" (新聞報)
on August 31, 1939, Mr. C.S. Lee (李澤祥), the
advertiser, was interviewed at headquarters on the
morning of September 4. He stated that Ling Tsoh-
wei (林卓慧), the person to whom the advertisement
was addressed, is his wife who had absconded several
days previously with clothing and valuables and that
he had already reported the matter to Sinza Police
Station.

                                          E. M. Golder
                                          D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

(印：FILE C 4/9)
page_data.zh:
表格编号 3
G./65M-1-39

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案编号............
                              S.5，特别支部提交件 9417
报告                          日期：1939年9月4日。6 9 39

主题（全称）......关于1939年8月31日《新闻报》上刊登的一则奇特广告。

呈报人................及........................转呈人.......副督察长 Golder

就附上的1939年8月31日《新闻报》（Sin Wan Pao）所刊广告的译文而言，广告主李泽祥先生（Mr. C.S. Lee）于9月4日上午在总局接受了问询。他称，该广告所指的对象林卓慧（Ling Tsoh-wei）是其妻子，她于数日前携带衣物及贵重物品潜逃，且他已就此事项向新闸捕房报案。

                                          E. M. Golder
                                          副督察长

特别支部主管警官。

（印：FILE C 4/9）

page_data.en:
A STRANGE ADVERTISEMENT

The following advertisement published by ?
one Ziang (祥 ) and addressed to a person named Ling
Tsgh-wei (林卓慧 ) appears in today's issue of the
"Sin Wan Pao": - 31.8.39 (P.M.)

"On the night of the 27th, you, by
unlawful means, took away a pistol, some money and other
things and escaped. Your act constitutes a violation of
the law and unless you surrender to the Police within
three days, you will be held responsible should the Police
take the matter up against you. Please reflect, or else
you will repent."

S.S.
C. ¼
page_data.zh:
一则奇特的广告

以下由一名姓祥（Ziang）者发布、致名为林卓慧（Ling Tsgh-wei）之人的广告，刊登于今日出版的《新闻报》上：- 1939年8月31日（下午）

“二十七日夜，你以非法手段取走手枪一支、现金若干及其他物品后逃逸。你的行为构成违法，除非你在三日内向警方自首，否则若警方对此事追究，你将承担责任。请三思，以免后悔。”

S.S.
C. ¼
